capabilities: sync a vault across devices through a private GitHub repository
resolve conflicts with three-way merge using file sizes and timestamps
skip unchanged files via delta hashing and metadata timestamps
transfer binary files byte for byte and skip files over 25 MB
view sync history in a log and live status in the status bar
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not use a local Git installation; it talks to GitHub's REST API directly.
extras: Detailed setup, authentication modes, commands and troubleshooting are in a separate USAGE.md file. Files over 25 MB are skipped. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's paid Sync service and local Git workflows don't suit users who want free GitHub-based cross-device sync, including mobile, without installing Git.

requires.name: GitHub account with Personal Access Token

summary: Syncs an Obsidian vault across devices using a private GitHub repository via the REST API, without needing local Git.
